name: Shipment delay priority for human review (demo)
description: Synthetic demo scenario: rank delayed shipments from a demo export for logistics-human review only. It never authorizes ERP write-back.
processNode: Daily demo shipment-export triage before a logistics coordinator manually decides follow-up.
decisionOrAction: Rank delayed shipments for human review; do not change ERP records or automatically execute operational actions.

metrics.name: Daily triage cycle time
metrics.definition: Minutes from opening the daily demo shipment export to a human-ready ranked review list.
metrics.baseline: 45 minutes per daily batch (synthetic demo baseline)
metrics.target: 15 minutes per daily batch (synthetic demo target)

ontologyReferences.purpose: Released synthetic semantic definitions for shipment, delay, priority recommendation, and triage-cycle-time.

sourceReferences.purpose: Synthetic read-only shipment snapshot used by this replayable demo.

acceptanceCriteria: A demo query returns a ranked human-review list with semantic version, source evidence, freshness, and access decision.
A record missing a required decision input is escalated without a score.
No persistent ERP action is executed by this demo.
notes: Approved only inside the synthetic demo sandbox; see evidence/assurance.json. This is not evidence of enterprise approval.
